segments.contextBefore: To programmatically determine when a process is running under Rosetta translation, call the [`sysctlbyname`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/kernel/1387446-sysctlbyname) function with the `sysctl.proc_translated` flag, as shown in the following example.

segments.normalizedSource: ```occ int processIsTranslated() { int ret = 0; size_t size = sizeof(ret); if (sysctlbyname("sysctl.proc_translated", &ret, &size, NULL, 0) == -1) { if (errno == ENOENT) return 0; return -1; } return ret; } ```
